item.title: PGTI 72TheLeague: Kartik Singh’s Grit Steals The Show On Opening Day
item.description: Jaypee Greens Golf Course: Kartik Singh, who recently turned 16, provided a stunning start to the PGTI’s 72 The League when the Mumbai Aces teenager took the in-form American Jhared Hack of Nava Raipur to the 18th hole of a fascinating battle, before halving his match at the Classic Golf & Country Club in Nuh, Haryana.

item.title: ECB insist Pakistani players will not be frozen out the Hundred
item.description: Pakistani players will not be discriminated against in selection for the Hundred, the England and Wales Cricket Board said on Tuesday, despite reports they could be overlooked due to political tensions with India.

item.title: Odisha FC, Inter Kashi Play Out Goalless Draw in ISL 2025-26 Gameweek 2
item.description: Odisha FC and Inter Kashi FC settled for a 0-0 draw in Gameweek 2 of the ISL 2025-26 at Kalinga Stadium, with Rahul KP named Player of the Match.

item.title: Ranji Trophy Final: 'Opportunities Like This Don't Come Again,' Says Pundir After Century Against Karnataka
item.description: Ranji Trophy Final: Jammu and Kashmir batter Shubham Pundir revealed that his goal was to make the best use of the opportunity and bat as long as possible after he scored a historic century against Karnataka in the Ranji Trophy Final at the Hubli Cricket Ground.

item.title: Sorloth's Hat-trick Take Atletico Madrid In Champions League Last 16
item.description: Atletico Madrid: Alexander Sorloth was the hero for Atletico Madrid as the powerful striker scored a hat-trick to see his side past a valiant Club Brugge, who, especially in the first half, gave Atletico problems.

item.title: T20 WC: Shastri Calls India’s Loss A ‘timely Shake-up’ After South Africa Thrashing In Super 8s
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former India head coach Ravi Shastri believes India’s crushing 76-run defeat to South Africa in the Super Eights of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup could serve as a much-needed wake-up call rather than a fatal blow to their semi-final hopes.

item.title: Leverkusen Advance To Champions League Last 16 After Controlling Olympiacos
item.description: Champions League: Leverkusen progressed to the Champions League round of 16 after a goalless draw with Olympiacos, comfortably protecting its first-leg cushion at home.

item.title: T20 WC: Road To Semis Scenario For Pakistan After Narrrow Loss To England
item.description: T20 World Cup: England became the first team to seal their semi-final spot at the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 after beating Pakistan, whose chances for semi-final qualification have taken a hit.

item.title: Champions League: Bodo/Glimt Enter Last 16 For First Time, Newcastle Also Prevail
item.description: UEFA Champions League: Bodo/Glimt held off a concerted comeback effort from Inter Milan to earn a place in the UEFA Champions League round of 16 for the first time with 5-2 aggregate win.

item.title: Ponting Urges India To 'go Back To The Basics' For Super 8 Clash Against Windies
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former Australia captain Ricky Ponting believes India must move away from overthinking match-ups and instead focus on fielding their strongest XI following the 76-run defeat to South Africa in the Super Eights of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup.
